description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the DefaultMapperLimitsConfig class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It verifies immutability, equality/hashcode behavior, and correct configuration value loading.

classes.name: DefaultMapperLimitsConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultMapperLimitsConfig, verifying configuration reading, immutability, and equality.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test configuration before any tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultMapperLimitsConfig implements hashCode and equals correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
